name: Spaceship 7860a67a on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003
description: A period-4 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003 (touching neighbours), 7 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 256 rules from B45/S34 to B4,5,8,9,10/S0,3,4,7,8,9,10; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k2-004, k3-010 and k3-016. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-016 (seen 249 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
